description.html: This 70x50x50 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 175 liters comes with a handmade 3D background that gives the interior the look of a natural habitat. The polystyrene background is sculpted as rock, tree bark or cave relief, and every piece is unique because it is made by hand in our workshop.

With a floor area of 70x50 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
